text: XDS is a Chinese bicycle and carbon-products manufacturer based in Shenzhen (brand XDS, premium bikes line X-LAB) whose bikes and equipment the XDS Astana Team races on; Cyclingnews described the company as a Chinese carbon product manufacturer that has become a major investor in the team.
short: XDS is a Shenzhen-based Chinese bike maker and the team's title sponsor.

source.name: Cyclingnews — 12 new riders, new bikes and now a new name: changes keep coming at Astana Qazaqstan after Chinese investment (James Moultrie)
source.quote: With Chinese carbon product manufacturer XDS Carbon-Tech on board as a sponsor for 2025 ... The Shenzen-based company has become a major investor in the team
source.note: Quote spans two sentences of the article, joined with ellipsis; 'Shenzen' [sic] as written on the page.

additionalSources.name: XDS / X-LAB official site — A Championship Track Record
additionalSources.quote: XDS is the official sponsor of the XDS Astana Team in the WorldTour. Built for power, precision, and pure speed, our X-LAB bikes help world-class athletes go beyond what was once the limit
